# Agent Python Tools

- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/depthcontrast

## File: facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_party/OpenPCDet/pcdet/datasets/nuscenes/nuscenes_dataset.py

Prompts

```
['create nuscenes dataset info pickle files for train and val splits with configurable max sweeps', 'create a ground truth database of 3D bounding box point clouds from nuscenes lidar sweeps', 'perform class-balanced resampling of nuscenes dataset samples to equalize class distribution', 'retrieve lidar point clouds with optional historical sweeps and time lag appended as a feature', 'generate prediction dictionaries from model output tensors for nuscenes detection evaluation', 'build a python module to create train and val info dicts with lidar sweeps and annotations from a NuScenes dataset', 'create a function that filters and returns only NuScenes scenes with valid existing LiDAR data files', 'build a python module to retrieve the data path, 3D boxes, and camera intrinsics for a given NuScenes sample_data token', 'create a function that converts detection annotations into the NuScenes evaluation submission JSON format with attributes', 'summarize the NuScenes detection metrics including per-class AP, TP errors, mAP, and NDS into a formatted report string']
```

Usage

```
{'create_nuscenes_info': 'create nuscenes dataset info pickle files for train and val splits with configurable max sweeps', 'create_groundtruth_database': 'create a ground truth database of 3D bounding box point clouds from nuscenes lidar sweeps', 'balanced_infos_resampling': 'perform class-balanced resampling of nuscenes dataset samples to equalize class distribution', 'get_lidar_with_sweeps': 'retrieve lidar point clouds with optional historical sweeps and time lag appended as a feature', 'generate_prediction_dicts': 'generate prediction dictionaries from model output tensors for nuscenes detection evaluation'}
```

facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.get_lidar_with_sweeps: retrieve lidar point clouds with optional historical sweeps and time lag appended as a feature
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.generate_prediction_dicts: generate prediction dictionaries from model output tensors for nuscenes detection evaluation

facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.fill_trainval_infos: build a python module to create train and val info dicts with lidar sweeps and annotations from a NuScenes dataset
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.get_available_scenes: create a function that filters and returns only NuScenes scenes with valid existing LiDAR data files
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.get_sample_data: build a python module to retrieve the data path, 3D boxes, and camera intrinsics for a given NuScenes sample_data token
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.transform_det_annos_to_nusc_annos: create a function that converts detection annotations into the NuScenes evaluation submission JSON format with attributes
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.format_nuscene_results: summarize the NuScenes detection metrics including per-class AP, TP errors, mAP, and NDS into a formatted report string
